description: Na₂Ca₄YZrSi₄(O₅F)₃ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three O and three F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.71 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.70 Å. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) Na-F bond length. There are four inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to three O and three F atoms to form distorted CaO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₅F octahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CaO₃F₃ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-65°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.41 Å. There are a spread of Ca-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.36 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.79 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.22 Å. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded to five O and one F atom to form CaO₅F octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CaO₅F octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one YO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-61°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.51 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.31 Å. In the fourth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.55 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.26 Å. Y is bonded to five O and one F atom to form YO₅F octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₃F₃ octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-65°. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.29 Å. The Y-F bond length is 2.31 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₅F octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-61°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.37 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one YO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two CaO₃F₃ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-75°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent YO₅F octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-54°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₃F₃ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one YO₅F octahedra, corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-54°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one YO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two CaO₃F₃ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-74°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Zr atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Zr tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with five ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Zr tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids that share corners with two FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONaCa₂Zr tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Ca and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ca, one Y, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Zr tetrahedra, corners with four FNaCa₂Y tetrahedra, and edges with two ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Y, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ca, one Y, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Zr tetrahedra, corners with four FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Zr tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramid. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ca, one Y, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and two Si atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids that share corners with five FNaCa₂Y tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Y, and one Si atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Y atom to form FNaCa₂Y tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with five ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramids, and edges with two FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Ca atoms to form FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNaCa₂Y tetrahedra, corners with three ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramids, edges with two FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid. In the third F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Ca atoms to form FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaCa₂Zr tetrahedra, corners with seven ONaCaYSi trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Zr tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid.
